consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1994-10-18 show at Madison Square Garden had some strong moments, particularly in the second set. Highlights include a solid performance of 'Days Between' and a unique rendition of 'Iko Iko,' though some felt the first set was forgettable.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 22 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there were notable highlights, several fans expressed disappointment with parts of the performance, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
